articles.title: RPM Elects Jeffrey D. Rowe to Its Board of Directors
articles.description: RPM International has announced the election of Jeffrey D. Rowe to its board of directors. Rowe, currently Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer at Archer-Daniels-Midland Company, brings extensive experience in global operations, supply chain management, and innovation to the coatings group.
